import time

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm
scan.Scantime = 0.1  # Time per line: 0.1s
scan.Lines = 32  # Lines per frame: 32

# Set Z controller parameters
zcontrol.PGain = 100
zcontrol.IGain = 6000
zcontrol.DGain = 10

# Function to wait for scan completion and new file
def wait_for_scan():
    time.sleep(4)  # Initial wait for scan to start
    while scan.IsScanning:
        time.sleep(1)
    time.sleep(1)  # Additional wait to ensure file is saved

# Perform scans
for i in range(3):
    print(f"Starting scan {i+1}...")
    scan.StartFrameUp()
    wait_for_scan()

del spm
